sentences.japanese: 起きた時私は悲しかった。
sentences.english: When I woke up, I was sad.

sentences.japanese: 誰かが亡くなったときは悲しいものだよ。
sentences.english: It's a pity when somebody dies.

sentences.japanese: これは何とも悲しい物語です。
sentences.english: This is such a sad story.

sentences.japanese: 君がそんなに悲しそうに泣くのは聞いていられない。
sentences.english: I can't abide hearing you cry so bitterly.

sentences.japanese: 近所の人々はみな彼の死をいたみ悲しんだ。
sentences.english: The whole neighborhood mourned his death.
